subject: Implement delegate_to_codex tool (Codex spawn + reader)
description:
**Blocked on the §5.4/§7.5 spec amendment** (which captures S-1 findings). Once that lands, build `capo/tools/codex.py` with a `delegate_to_codex(brief: CodexBrief)` tool that mirrors `delegate_to_claude_code` lifecycle: persist row → spawn → register DBOS workflow → return handle.

`CodexBrief` fields: `goal`, `repo_path`, `sandbox` (default from config), `constraints`, `success_criteria`, `relevant_files`, `model: str | None`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `CodexBrief` model defined with all fields per §5.4.
- [ ] Tool follows same persistence-before-yield contract as CC.
- [ ] Spawn argv exactly per the amended §7.5 Codex section.
- [ ] Output reader follows the dispatched-by-agent strategy: CC reads `--output-format json` events; Codex reads its equivalent per amended §7.5.
- [ ] `check_delegation_status`, `get_delegation_output`, `kill_delegation` work for Codex delegations identically.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `agents.codex.enabled = false`: tool not registered (per §11.2 feature flag).
- [ ] `repo_path` outside `projects_root`: same approval gate as CC.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: brief model validation
• Integration: full Codex spawn → row inserted → reader streams → handle returned (uses cheap-model mock if real Codex unavailable in CI)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.4, 7.5, 9.4 (after spec amendment)
